text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Black: shifted target (observed power plus the injected shift). Dashed purple: observed power. Bands: q05 to q95. Forecasts with lead 24 to 48 h, 2025-12, leave-one-month-out, mean over five seeds. In these examples H1 lags the target by about 2 days at onset and carries the shift for about 3 days after it ends.'
text.tspan: Black: shifted target (observed power plus the injected shift). Dashed purple: observed power. Bands: q05 to q95.
Forecasts with lead 24 to 48 h, 2025-12, leave-one-month-out, mean over five seeds.
In these examples H1 lags the target by about 2 days at onset and carries the shift for about 3 days after it ends.
